summary_en: A new vowel and a new way to write m: a doctor, a hospital, and where to find one.
notes: Owner 2026-11-19 (added to the outing run after the bathroom lesson; the planned lesson 19 with ຢາກ moves to 20). Units V18 ໂ◌ (pure 'oh'; contrasted with ◌ໍ, both in ໂຮງໝໍ) and C31 ໝ (same sound as ມ; melody learned with each word, class rule waits). Core words W000162 doctor, W000172 hospital (word note explains ໂຮງ 'building', not ຫ້ອງ 'room'). Bonus W000095 dog (ໝ; tone twin of ມາ), W000142 hour (ໂ◌ + final ງ). Sentences S000002926 She's a doctor, S000002925 I'm going to the hospital (composed), S000000309 Where is the hospital?, S000000310 She is in the hospital (existing). All unverified.
